decisions.reason: This navigation and observation camera draws on the firm's core heritage and still has its own page; space procurement cycles are long and keeping it costs little, so its upside remains open.
The modular camera line has several models and fits the firm's push toward flexible sensors for small satellites, so it holds multiple growth options at low marginal cost.

The miniaturized LiDAR is still only mentioned on the website and its uncertainty is unresolved, but it fits the docking and small-satellite direction and costs little to keep, so the option is retained.
This radiation-hard camera line was launched in 2024 with its own page and sits close to the established offer, so it is far too early to judge and cheap to keep.
The asteroid navigation camera is new and tied to long-horizon missions, so its value has not yet been revealed and keeping it at low cost preserves the option.
